subject.title: Feature: trustedWebhooks for Discord — allow specific webhooks to trigger agent responses

question: Should Discord accept a new guild-scoped trusted webhook authority surface, and may that surface map webhook payloads onto a configured Discord user identity?
rationale: The requested allowlist is narrower than allowBots=true, but it gives Discord webhook possession authority to enter agent sessions and the proposed mapToUser option crosses authorization and session-identity boundaries.

options.title: Approve allowlist without identity mapping
options.body: Permit a strict webhook-id allowlist to pass the bot-message gate while keeping user impersonation out until a separate authorization contract is approved.

options.title: Approve webhook-to-user mapping
options.body: Allow mapToUser only with validation against configured guild users, audit/logging behavior, and tests proving it cannot bypass sender authorization or session isolation.

options.title: Decline Discord-specific webhook ingress
options.body: Keep Discord bot-message policy unchanged and direct external automation to authenticated Gateway hooks or a ClawHub integration instead.

recommendation.title: Approve allowlist without identity mapping
recommendation.body: Permit a strict webhook-id allowlist to pass the bot-message gate while keeping user impersonation out until a separate authorization contract is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Discord preflight ownership and adjacent merge history make this the best available owner for the security/product choice.
